run_demo_optical_flow: run the RAFT demo to compute optical flow between consecutive images in a directory
load_image_tensor: load an image file and convert it to a PyTorch tensor with channel-first format
load_image_list_batch: load multiple images into a batched tensor, move to CUDA, and pad for processing
visualize_flow: visualize optical flow by converting flow tensor to RGB image and saving as PNG
initialize_raft_inference: initialize a RAFT model with pretrained weights for optical flow inference
